pages.text: Akaishi Energy is this mod's "electricity": almost every machine runs on it.$(br2)$(bold)One line to remember:$(0) if you want automation, feed the grid first.$(br2)A power grid is made of four jobs:$(li)$(4)Generate$(0): the "$(l:akaishi:generator)Energy Generator$(/l)" burns fuel into power; later come the Reactor and Fusion Reactor for mass output$(li)$(4)Store$(0): "$(l:akaishi:energy_cell)Energy Cells$(/l)"$(li)$(4)Transport$(0): "$(l:akaishi:energy_pipe)Energy Pipes$(/l)" carry power to every machine$(li)$(4)Carry$(0): "$(l:akaishi:portable_cell)Portable Cells$(/l)" power you on the go$(br2)Build the generator first, then cells, then pipe your machines into one grid — the order matters, you can't skip a step.

$(bold)Five fuel tiers$(0) (heating value, low to high):$(li)Akaishi Crystal$(li)Raw Akaishi Block$(li)Akaishi Essence$(li)Condensed Akaishi Essence$(li)Condensed Akaishi Essence Block$(br2)Each step up is worth roughly 10x the heating value, refined through the chain described in "$(l:akaishi:crystal)Akaishi Crystals & Essence$(/l)".$(br2)$(bold)Reading big numbers:$(0) machine UIs abbreviate large values: K=thousand, M=million, B=billion. The better you refine your fuel, the longer and stronger each burn lasts — one extra refining step saves ten refills.
After this page, read in order: Energy Generator → Energy Cells → Energy Pipes to complete your first power grid.
